history.summary: Compact 872sqft 3BR at Buangkok MRT (280m), $1.68M / $1,927psf. Excellent transit liquidity (176 URA txns, deep buyer pool) but the asking PSF is a steep ~5% above URA median ($1,838) for a small-format 3BR squeezed into under 900sqft.
history.rating_rationale: Strengths: 3-min walk to NE15 Buangkok is a genuine liquidity and rental driver; 176 transactions is a deep, reliable base; 6.07%/yr CAGR is solid. But asking $1,927psf is ~4.8% over the $1,838 URA median — paying up. At 872sqft this is a very tight 3BR (shoebox-ish per bedroom), which narrows the family buyer pool that 3BRs normally rely on. 99yr from 2012 leaves ~85yrs — fine. MMR 682 / off frontier is middling. The MRT proximity rescues it from Avoid, but the PSF premium on a cramped layout caps it at Neutral.

history.summary: CDL development 340m from NE15 Buangkok MRT, priced ~6% below the URA median ($1733 vs $1838) with a respectable 6.07% CAGR over 176 transactions. A compact 721sqft 2BR with good connectivity and a quality developer — a clean, if not spectacular, OCR investment buy.
history.rating_rationale: Strong location fundamentals: 340m to Buangkok MRT (NE line, direct to CBD), CDL build, 616 units for adequate liquidity. Listed ~6% below the URA median PSF, so not overpaying. 6.07% resale CAGR over a solid 176 transactions is reliable. The high absolute PSF ($1733) reflects the compact unit size and is in line with the area. Sengkang/Buangkok benefits from NE-line accessibility and broad HDB-upgrader demand. Minor reported nuisance (mosquitoes) is immaterial. Not a Strong Buy because OCR appreciation is moderate and there's no near-term step-change catalyst at the doorstep.
